title: 403 — a supervisor session cannot move value
description: The four mutating HTLC routes are gated to ROLE_BANK, ROLE_COMMERCIAL_BANK, ROLE_TREASURY and ROLE_GOVERNANCE, so an oversight-only session (ROLE_SUPERVISOR or ROLE_NOC) holding a perfectly valid cookie still cannot lock, settle or refund.
notes: Verified in the delivered gateway (internal/http/middleware/require_role.go and the router's HTLC group). The platform OpenAPI document declares no 403 on any HTLC operation; contracts/pvp adds it as implementation-observed. The body carries an undocumented required_role array alongside error — treat it as advisory and assert on the status. A second, different 403 exists on these routes: a caller with the right role who is not a counterparty of the HTLC gets {"error": "not a counterparty of this HTLC"} with no required_role.
